description: Establish a green baseline before any code changes. Create a dedicated git worktree branch off origin/dev (per .kiro/steering/agent-workflow.md and AGENTS.md hygiene rules), install dependencies with uv, and run the focused unit tests that the issue's reproduction touches so subsequent diff-driven verification has a clean reference point. No code modifications in this feature.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/rag, confirm git status is clean and current branch is `dev`. Then create a feature branch named `fix/1401-furniture-furnished-schema` directly on the current checkout (the workspace is already isolated for this task, so a separate worktree path is not required; AGENTS.md only mandates that you do not start non-trivial edits in a dirty checkout).

Install dependencies: `uv sync --all-extras --all-groups`. If the network refuses package downloads, stop here and mark this feature `blocked` with `retryable: true` and `detail` describing the network failure — do not fall back to partial installs.

Run focused baseline tests for the modules this issue touches and capture the summary lines (pass counts, durations) in `findings`: `uv run --python 3.12 pytest tests/unit/services/test_filter_extractor.py tests/unit/services/test_query_filter_signal.py tests/unit/scripts/test_apartments_setup_collection.py -q --timeout=30`.

Run the fast unit lane for sanity: `PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-n auto --dist=worksteal' make test-unit`. If pre-existing failures unrelated to this issue appear, record them verbatim under `findings` so later diffs do not regress them — do not try to fix them in this feature.

Set FEAT-001 status to `completed` only after both pytest invocations finish without new failures. Record the captured pytest summary lines and the exact baseline commit hash (`git rev-parse HEAD`) under `findings`.
acceptance_criteria: Branch `fix/1401-furniture-furnished-schema` exists locally and is checked out.

`uv run --python 3.12 pytest tests/unit/services/test_filter_extractor.py tests/unit/services/test_query_filter_signal.py tests/unit/scripts/test_apartments_setup_collection.py -q --timeout=30` exits 0 and the `findings` field of this feature contains the summary line.
`PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-n auto --dist=worksteal' make test-unit` exits 0 (or its pre-existing failures are recorded verbatim in `findings` and confirmed unrelated to furniture/furnished symbols).
findings: Baseline established on branch fix/1401-furniture-furnished-schema at commit f3a6bfb9c3cd22297c963559185be8117d2830c6 (off origin/dev, working tree clean apart from untracked .agents/ task state). `uv sync --all-extras --all-groups` exited 0 (full set of extras + groups installed, including torch==2.11.0+cpu / transformers==5.5.4 / qdrant-client transitively). Focused baseline pytest summary: `143 passed in 11.82s` for `uv run --python 3.12 pytest tests/unit/services/test_filter_extractor.py tests/unit/services/test_query_filter_signal.py tests/unit/scripts/test_apartments_setup_collection.py -q --timeout=30`. Fast unit lane summary: `7 failed, 6935 passed, 1 skipped, 192 warnings in 73.26s (0:01:13)` for `PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-n auto --dist=worksteal' make test-unit` (exit 1). The 7 failures are pre-existing on the base SHA (HEAD == base, no production edits in this feature) and are unrelated to furniture/furnished — verified by grep for `furniture|furnished|is_furnished` against each failing test file (no matches). Pre-existing failure list (verbatim from pytest short summary): tests/unit/services/test_ingestion_cocoindex.py::test_main_without_args_exits_with_usage; tests/unit/services/test_ingestion_cocoindex.py::test_main_ingest_dir_without_path_exits; tests/unit/services/test_ingestion_cocoindex.py::test_main_unknown_command_exits; tests/unit/test_docker_static_validation.py::test_compose_dev_config_renders; tests/unit/test_docker_static_validation.py::test_compose_dev_config_renders_with_full_profile; tests/unit/scripts/test_check_markdown_links.py::test_current_repository_markdown_links_are_valid; tests/unit/dialogs/test_dialogs_fsm_coverage.py::test_every_declared_state_is_referenced_by_a_dialog. Subsequent features must keep this 7-failure / 6935-pass shape (or fewer failures) intact and must not introduce regressions in the focused 143-test set.
